privacy-text-approved.what: The privacy policy's final text is written by UX & PM, approved by Vitor, and every claim in it matches what the system enforces today (W3).

terms-text-approved.what: The terms of use's final text is written by UX & PM and approved by Vitor (W3).

delete-account-live.what: Me → Delete account (type DELETE, confirm) works in a RELEASED app build and on the live web journal, and deletes every row plus the auth user immediately (M7 + the web Me screen).

backup-retention.what: Mobile Dev confirmed in the Supabase dashboard how many days backups are kept (plan + PITR status), and BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS in src/lib/site.ts holds that number.

web-journal-live.what: The signed-in web journal (W0 shell + onboarding + Today, at parity with the released app) is live for users, with Vitor's go. Gates /app, /sign-in, /forgot-password and the "Continue on the web" button.

ai-memory.what: The AI memory screen (Me → What Moodbow remembers: see, edit, delete facts) is live on the app and the web (R2).

purchases.what: AI credit purchases (Google Play / App Store) are live, with the refund rule enforced (R2).

appearance-setting.what: Me → Appearance (system / light / dark) is live, and the choice is stored in the account settings.

app-lock.what: The app lock (PIN or fingerprint/face, PIN kept only on the device) is in a RELEASED app build (M7).

share-cards.what: Share cards (made on the device, leaving it only when the user shares) are in a RELEASED app build and on the web (M10).

ai-live.what: AI reflections and reports are switched on for users (the AI flag on, decision D2), with the free Lite allowance enforced server-side.

starter-credits.what: New accounts get starter credits after confirming their email (app_config.starter_credits > 0, enforced server-side).
